# ToggleButton { #anylumino.ToggleButton }

```python
ToggleButton(
    value=False,
    description='',
    icon='',
    disabled=False,
    button_style='',
    tooltip='',
    icon_family='classic',
    icon_variant='solid',
    icon_library='default',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Boolean toggle-button control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type     | Description                                                           | Default     |
|--------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `False` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| indent | optional | Whether checkbox labels are indented. | `True` |
| icon | optional | Web Awesome icon name. | `''` |
| button_style | optional | Visual variant such as ``'primary'``, ``'success'``, or ``'danger'``. | `''` |
| tooltip | optional | Hover text. | `''` |
| icon_family | optional | Web Awesome icon family, for example ``'classic'``. | `'classic'` |
| icon_variant | optional | Web Awesome icon variant, for example ``'solid'`` or ``'regular'``. | `'solid'` |
| icon_library | optional | Web Awesome icon library, for example ``'default'``. | `'default'` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.ToggleButton.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
